subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` wait and replay the original Gateway run after an ambiguous disconnect before preserving the current automatic embedded fallback, and what exactly should happen when that bounded recovery expires?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes the established disconnect reflex and its user-visible timing/output semantics; repository policy treats fallback behavior as a product decision, and the linked canonical issue remains open for that choice.

options.title: Adopt bounded recovery first
options.body: Approve wait-and-cache-only replay first, retain automatic isolated fallback after the documented deadline, and require final-head proof of both paths.

options.title: Keep recook-first
options.body: Reject the new recovery-first behavior and retain the current immediate isolated embedded fallback after uncertain disconnects.

options.title: Pause for a narrower policy
options.body: Keep the PR draft until maintainers define distinct behavior for interactive and `--deliver` invocations.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded recovery first
recommendation.body: Approve wait-and-cache-only replay first, retain automatic isolated fallback after the documented deadline, and require final-head proof of both paths.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current fallback containment whose compatibility contract the PR changes.
